posts.caption: OpenAI's custom AI chip is a game-changer for the tech industry. With its partnership with Broadcom, OpenAI aims to revolutionize AI computing. But what does this mean for the future of AI?

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: OpenAI launched its first in-house AI chip in partnership with Broadcom.
The custom AI chip is designed to improve AI processing efficiency.
This development marks a significant milestone in OpenAI's hardware efforts.
The partnership aims to enhance AI capabilities with customized chip design.

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: Custom AI chips can significantly enhance AI model performance.
This innovation can lead to improved efficiency and reduced costs for AI computing.
The development of custom AI chips is a growing trend in the tech industry.
It has the potential to impact various sectors, including healthcare, finance, and education.

slide4.title: INSIGHTS
bullets: The use of custom AI chips can increase AI adoption across industries.
This trend may lead to increased competition among chip manufacturers.
As AI continues to evolve, custom chip design will play a crucial role.

posts.caption: The 2026 Cloud Security Report reveals a significant gap between traditional security architecture and AI transformation. As AI continues to advance, cloud security must catch up to address potential risks.

slide1.headline: Traditional Security Architecture Lagging Behind AI
slide1.subtitle: 2026 Cloud Security Report

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: The 2026 Cloud Security Report highlights the gap between traditional security architecture and AI transformation.
The report emphasizes the need for cloud security to catch up with AI advancements.
In 2026, 75% of organizations are expected to adopt cloud-based security solutions.
The report warns of potential security risks if traditional architecture is not adapted to AI.

slide3.title: INSIGHTS
bullets: The report stresses the importance of adapting traditional security architecture to AI.
Cloud security must evolve to address AI-related risks.
Organizations must prioritize cloud security to ensure AI adoption is secure.

posts.caption: Vishal Sikka's new AI startup Hang Ten Systems has secured $32 million in funding. The startup aims to provide AI services to various industries, and the funding will be used to develop innovative AI solutions.

slide1.headline: Vishal Sikka Launches AI Startup Hang Ten Systems
slide1.subtitle: Secures $32 Million in Funding

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Vishal Sikka, former Infosys CEO, launched AI startup Hang Ten Systems.
The startup secured $32 million in funding.
Hang Ten Systems aims to provide AI services to various industries.
The funding will be used to develop AI solutions and expand the team.

slide3.title: INSIGHTS
bullets: The funding will help Hang Ten Systems develop innovative AI solutions.
The startup's focus on AI services has the potential to disrupt various industries.
Vishal Sikka's experience in the tech industry will be valuable in leading the startup.
